ev.q: the pattern of activity was closer to the pattern seen when they thought about a stranger

1.why: C段。a comparison between thinking about oneself and thinking about someone else ↔ thought about themselves ten years in the future … closer to the pattern seen when they thought about a stranger。

ev.q: chronic procrastination has been linked with poorer finances

2.why: D段末句。money problems ↔ poorer finances；paying bills and completing tax returns 是例子。C段也提到存钱（save money），但那是关于想象未来的自己能让人更愿意存钱，不是拖延造成的金钱问题。

ev.q: such as 'I work better under pressure', which, he says, are rarely true

3.why: E段 Hart。an untrue belief that people use to excuse delay ↔ the excuses they make, such as 'I work better under pressure', which … are rarely true。

ev.q: Psychologists distinguish these deliberate decisions from procrastination, which they define as a voluntary delay that the person expects will make things worse.

4.why: G段。a definition that separates sensible waiting from procrastination ↔ distinguish these deliberate decisions from procrastination, which they define as…。

ev.q: around one in five adults regard themselves as chronic procrastinators

5.why: A段。an estimate of how common serious procrastination is ↔ around one in five adults regard themselves as chronic procrastinators。

ev.q: Putting it off brings immediate relief from these unpleasant feelings, even though the relief is short-lived

6.why: B段。A delaying a task reduces bad feelings for a while ↔ Putting it off brings immediate relief from these unpleasant feelings … short-lived。B 是这一观点明确否定的（not because they cannot organise their time）；C 是E段提到的借口。

ev.q: became much more stressed, and fell ill more often, towards the end of it

7.why: D段。C became more stressed and unwell later on ↔ became much more stressed, and fell ill more often, towards the end of it。A 只对了一半：学期初确实压力较小（felt less stressed than others early in the term），但不是整个学期；B 与 lower marks 相反。

ev.q: In practice, many people find that once they have started, they carry on.

8.why: E段。D It often leads people to keep working ↔ once they have started, they carry on。A、C 与原文相反；B 文中没有这种限制。

ev.q: those who forgave themselves for procrastinating before the first exam procrastinated less before the second

9.why: F段。B Forgiving oneself was linked to less delay later ↔ those who forgave themselves … procrastinated less before the second。A 是常见想法，但研究结果正好相反（the opposite appears to be true）；C 与 guilt adds to the negative feelings 相反。

ev.q: procrastination was seen simply as a problem of laziness or of poor time management

10.why: A段。put down to ↔ seen simply as a problem of；weak ___ ↔ poor time management。

ev.q: A task may be boring, difficult or associated with a fear of failure.

11.why: B段。afraid of ↔ a fear of。boring、difficult 也是原因，但不能接在 afraid of 后面。

ev.q: One is to break a large task into very small steps, so that the first step seems manageable

12.why: E段。Splitting a large job into tiny ↔ break a large task into very small；make the start feel manageable ↔ the first step seems manageable。

ev.q: guilt adds to the negative feelings that caused the delay in the first place

13.why: F段末句。makes the bad feelings … even stronger ↔ adds to the negative feelings；behind the delay ↔ that caused the delay。self-criticism 也说得通，但原文这一句的主语是 guilt。
